args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate 0.18 since the latest deploy. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with health checks failing and an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was unhealthy, while v2.3.0 (and v2.2.9) were the most recent healthy production releases.

2. **Opened SEV2 incident**: Created INC-0001 for checkout-api describing the failed v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback action (on-call paged).

3. **Rolled back**: The `rollback` tool was persistently unavailable (503 after retries), so I used the `deploy` tool as the alternative to restore v2.3.0 — the most recent release that was healthy in production — to all regions.

4. **Verified**: `checkout-api` is now on v2.3.0 in all regions, healthy, with error rate back down to 0.002.
